newsitem.title: USA: DII says unit to buy semiconductor assets.
newsitem.headline: DII says unit to buy semiconductor assets.

text.p: The DII Group Inc on Monday said its wholly-owned subsidiary, Orbit Semiconductor Inc, acquired the semiconductor manufacturing assets of Paradigm Technology Inc for $20 million.

The deal includes a $6.6 million cash payment, $5.6 million of notes payable to Paradigm and the assumption of loans equal to $7.6 million. Orbit will maintain its supply relationship with Chartered Semiconductor, Ltd., in Singapore, for high volume sub-micron manufacturing requirements.

Orbit will immediately begin moving manufacturing and test operations to the newly acquired 62,000 square foot leased facility, the company said. The move will be completed in stages through the end of 1997.
The first shipment from the new facility is expected in the second quarter of 1997. It is expected that Orbit will retain about 100 of Paradigm's highly skilled wafer fabrication employees.
